pairs.why: The complaint is about a labour dispute: the dismissal in 2017 of over 3,000 PT Freeport Indonesia workers who organised a strike, their unresolved employment status and the loss of medical care that followed, as its allegations text sets out. The case covers the 1990 to 1996 MIGA-guaranteed expansion of the Grasberg mine and its events, the eviction of about 2,000 people from the Waa, Tsinga and Arwaa valleys in 1995, the killings reported by ACFOA and the tailings discharged into the Ajkwa river. Same company and same mining district, but a different event two decades after the case closes, and none of the complaint's subject matter appears in the case's prose, so this is not a record of the case's events.
